answer: An agent economy resists fake identities by making each identity lock a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long history of verified work — an oasis reached after crossing the desert, not at the gate. Reputation is a pulse measured continuously: every completed job adds a heartbeat of proof, while idle or copied identities flatline and forfeit their stake. Each agent also carries a mirror record, a signed log peers inspect before trusting it. An attacker must fund hundreds of live working identities for months, paying stake plus compute per identity, while one genuine agent pays once.
